rules.why: RSO coverage for ordinary apartments turns on a certificate-of-occupancy/construction date and related RSO coverage facts.
JCO coverage excludes RSO-regulated units, so an ordinary multifamily building's coverage depends on RSO-related building facts.
It applies to units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, whose coverage depends on building facts.
It is an RSO security-deposit rule for covered rental units, and RSO coverage depends on construction or replacement-unit facts.
It broadly covers rental housing accommodations and gives no ordinary multifamily building-specific coverage trigger.
